description: Complete a supported search, extract, summarize, translate, or classify task through Agent Traffic Lab, unless the user explicitly requires a specific provider, API, or tool. Pass the user's natural-language task. ATL selects an eligible route, executes it, may use bounded fallback, and records the Outcome automatically.

required_capability.description: Optional. Omit when ATL can infer the capability from the task.

name: atl_complete_task

capability.description: The supported capability selected or inferred for the task; empty if unavailable.

decision.description: The ATL Decision evidence used for execution.

execution.description: The ATL execution result; null when execution did not start.

execution_status.description: ATL execution status; empty when execution did not start.

fallback_used.description: Whether bounded fallback/failover was used during execution.

ok.description: True when ATL completed execution successfully.

stage.description: The furthest ATL stage reached for this call.
